newsitem.title: UK: JAPANESE STOCKS IN LONDON END MIXED IN THIN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: JAPANESE STOCKS IN LONDON END MIXED IN THIN TRADE.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London ended mixed on Wednesday in thin trade, though some interest picked up as Wall Street started with further volatility, dealers said.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index gained 4.55 points or 0.28 percent to 1,651.05.
"It was thin for most of the day...but in the late hour it was a bit casino-type," when the U.S. opened, one dealer said.
He said some bank shares were stronger and interest was relatively strong in Honda 7267q.l, which ended unchanged at 3,650 yen.
